turns.prompt_text: Can you do it from a photo?
turns.response_html:
That depends on what "it" is!

I can do many things with photos, such as:

  • Identify objects or people in the image.
  • Describe the scene or the contents of the photo.
  • Extract text from the image.
  • Answer questions based on the visual information.
  • Help you write a caption or a story about the photo.

Please upload the photo and tell me what you'd like me to do with it.
